items.summary: Models for physical AI tasks, such as robotics and autonomous driving, need not reason solely in language. items.summary: Reliable robotic manipulation requires both semantic understanding and precise control in three-dimensional space. items.summary: Target-conditioned diffusion drafters predict candidate tokens in parallel, yet each new block must wait for updated target-model hidden states. items.summary: Egocentric human video offers a scalable source of manipulation priors for robot learning, yet translating raw data scale into generalizable robot policies demands rigorous data curation and training recipes. items.summary: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows.
